model: SRH300D / SRH200D humidity and temperature transmitter (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Setra SRH300 and SRH200 humidity/temperature transmitters with the RS-485 BACnet MS/TP output (SRH300D / SRH200D).
summary: The SRH300D and SRH200D are Setra humidity and temperature transmitters that act as BACnet MS/TP smart sensors. The SRH300D exposes eight read-only Analog Inputs (temperature, RH and calculated psychrometric values); the SRH200D exposes only temperature and RH. Units follow the configured measurement units.
notes: Points from sections 11 and 12.2 of the PICS; object names are the short symbols printed there (T, RH, e, Td, dv, r, h, Tf).
The SRH200D has only AI 0 (T) and AI 1 (RH); AI 2-AI 7 exist on the SRH300D only.
Present_Value is writable only while Out_Of_Service is true (it then defaults to 50.0).
Absolute humidity in g/ft3 and mixing ratio in gr/lb use units codes that are not ASHRAE-defined.
Device instance defaults to 1 on the SRH300D and 2 on the SRH200D.

source.title: PICS SRH200D & SRH300D - BACnet Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP communication parameters and a unique device instance, then read temperature and RH (and dew point on the SRH300D). The device can also broadcast unsolicited COV when a COV increment is set.
setup: Default comms are 38,400 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit; change them with the writable Communication Parameter device property (e.g. "76800-8n1").
Device instance defaults to 1 (SRH300D) or 2 (SRH200D) and is writable; Max_Master (default 127) is writable.
Reinitialize Device and Device Communication Control need the password printed in the PICS.
gotchas: COV reporting is unsolicited broadcast (no subscriptions) and is off until COV_Increment is set below 1e9.
Changing the measurement units changes the AI Units and Description properties.
